preflight.note: Created before changing provider-specific onboarding, health, capability, messaging, tests, documentation, or evidence.

acceptance_criteria.text: Record the shipped Twilio-shaped frontend gaps and define the boundary between shared messaging behavior and provider-specific setup, capabilities, health, and actions.
Add an accessible first-run provider choice with distinct local-only, Twilio, and Telnyx setup paths that use each provider's actual credential and validation model.
Present separate Twilio and Telnyx configuration, help links, operator actions, and implemented capability boundaries without a generic credential abstraction.
Make overview and communications readiness derive from the explicitly selected provider and its provider-specific status rather than Twilio credential fields.
Surface the active SMS/MMS edge and its ForgeLink-supported capabilities in inbox/compose and reviewed-outbox workflows while retaining provider-neutral send semantics.
Preserve shared-renderer and Tauri posture, keyboard and screen-reader semantics, local-only operation, and renderer secret-redaction boundaries with deterministic tests.
Update operator documentation and changelog, rebuild the renderer artifact, record durable redacted evidence, regenerate the dashboard, and pass focused, full, secret-scan, and governed validation.
